newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus launches Australia managed data service.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus launches Australia managed data service.

text.p: Optus Communications, Australia's second largest telecommunications carrier, announced on Friday the launch of its Global Managed Data Services (GMDS).

The company said GMDS offered premium quality, reliable and cost effective international frame relay services to the corporate sector, bringing customers savings of up to 50 percent over leased line solutions.
GMDS provided connections to 27 countries including most major European and Asian destinations as well as the United States, it said in a statement.
Optus shareholder Cable and Wireless Plc would provide GMDS through its Global Digital Highway, an advanced managed platform using optical fibre networks around the world.
Cable and Wireless owns about 25 percent of Optus with Mayne Nickless Ltd and BellSouth Corp also holding about one quarter of the company each.
